## Take place

**Word Power 27 · Phrasal verbs**

### Meaning

To happen.

### Usage

1. Jaipur Literature Festival didn't take place last year.
2. Anju: Did the class take place yesterday? Sohan: No, the class didn't take place. The teacher was on leave.

### Your turn

Use “take place” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
